# Swoosh v1.26.2 - Table of Contents

> Compose, deliver and test your emails easily in Elixir. Supports SMTP,
Sendgrid, Mandrill, Postmark, Mailgun and many more out of the box.
Preview your emails in the browser. Test your email sending code.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Contributor Code of Conduct](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/code_of_conduct.md)
- [Contributing to Swoosh](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/contributing.md)

## Modules

- [Swoosh](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.md): [![hex.pm](https://img.shields.io/hexpm/v/swoosh.svg)](https://hex.pm/packages/swoosh)
[![hex.pm](https://img.shields.io/hexpm/dt/swoosh.svg)](https://hex.pm/packages/swoosh)
[![hex.pm](https://img.shields.io/hexpm/l/swoosh.svg)](https://hex.pm/packages/swoosh)
[![github.com](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/swoosh/swoosh.svg)](https://github.com/swoosh/swoosh)
- [Swoosh.Adapter](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapter.md): Specification of the email delivery adapter.

- [Swoosh.Adapters.Local.Storage.Manager](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Local.Storage.Manager.md): Manages the creation/monitoring of the global in-memory storage driver,
`Swoosh.Adapters.Local.Storage.Memory`

- [Swoosh.Adapters.Local.Storage.Memory](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Local.Storage.Memory.md): In-memory storage driver used by the
[Swoosh.Adapters.Local](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Local.html) module.
- [Swoosh.Application](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Application.md)
- [Swoosh.Attachment](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Attachment.md): Struct representing an attachment in an email.
- [Swoosh.Mailer](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Mailer.md): Defines a mailer.

- Email
  - [Swoosh.Email](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Email.md): Defines an Email.
  - [Swoosh.Email.Recipient](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Email.Recipient.md): Recipient Protocol controls how data is formatted into an email recipient

- Adapters
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.AmazonSES](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.AmazonSES.md): An adapter that sends email using the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) Query API.
This adapter does not depend on `ExAws`; if you are already using it, you may
prefer `Swoosh.Adapters.ExAwsAmazonSES`.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.AzureCommunicationServices](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.AzureCommunicationServices.md): An adapter that sends email using the Azure Communication Services (ACS) Email API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Brevo](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Brevo.md): An adapter that sends email using the Brevo API (Transactional emails only).
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.CustomerIO](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.CustomerIO.md): An adapter that sends email using the CustomerIO API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Dyn](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Dyn.md): An adapter that sends email using the Dyn API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.ExAwsAmazonSES](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.ExAwsAmazonSES.md): An adapter that wraps `Swoosh.Adapters.AmazonSES` to use credentials from `ExAws`.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Gmail](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Gmail.md): An adapter that sends email using Gmail api
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Lettermint](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Lettermint.md): An adapter that sends email using the Lettermint API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Local](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Local.md): An adapter that stores the email locally, using the specified storage driver.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Logger](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Logger.md): An adapter that only logs email using Logger.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Loops](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Loops.md): An adapter that sends email using the Loops API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.MailPace](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.MailPace.md): 
An adapter that sends email using the MailPace API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mailersend](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mailersend.md): An adapter that sends email using the MailerSend API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mailgun](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mailgun.md): An adapter that sends email using the Mailgun API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mailjet](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mailjet.md): An adapter that sends email using the Mailjet API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mailpit](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mailpit.md): An adapter that sends email to a self-hosted Mailpit server via its HTTP API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mailtrap](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mailtrap.md): An adapter that sends email using the Mailtrap API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mandrill](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mandrill.md): An adapter that sends email using the Mandrill API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.MsGraph](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.MsGraph.md): An adapter that sends email using the Microsoft Graph API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mua](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mua.md): An adapter for sending emails using the SMTP protocol.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.PostUp](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.PostUp.md): An adapter that sends email using the PostUp API, specifically triggered mailing. This
corresponds to transactional emails.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Postal](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Postal.md): An adapter that sends email using the Postal API.
[Postal](https://docs.postalserver.io/) is open-source, self-hosted mail delivery platform.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Postmark](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Postmark.md): An adapter that sends email using the Postmark API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.ProtonBridge](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.ProtonBridge.md): An adapter that sends email using the local Protonmail Bridge.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Resend](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Resend.md): An adapter that sends email using the Resend API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.SMTP](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.SMTP.md): An adapter that sends email using the SMTP protocol.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.SMTP2GO](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.SMTP2GO.md): An adapter that sends email using the SMTP2GO API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Sandbox](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Sandbox.md): A sandbox adapter for email delivery in tests, analogous to
[`Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox`](https://hexdocs.pm/ecto_sql/Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.html).
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Scaleway](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Scaleway.md): An adapter that sends email using the Scaleway API (Transactional emails only).
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Sendgrid](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Sendgrid.md): An adapter that sends email using the Sendgrid API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Sendmail](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Sendmail.md): An adapter that sends email using the sendmail binary.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.SocketLabs](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.SocketLabs.md): An adapter that sends email using the SocketLabs Injection API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.SparkPost](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.SparkPost.md): An adapter that sends email using the SparkPost API.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Test](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Test.md): An adapter that sends emails as messages to the current process.
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.ZeptoMail](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.ZeptoMail.md): An adapter that sends transactional email using the ZeptoMail API.

- Api Client
  - [Swoosh.ApiClient](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.ApiClient.md): Specification for a Swoosh API client.
  - [Swoosh.ApiClient.Finch](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.ApiClient.Finch.md): Finch-based ApiClient for Swoosh.
  - [Swoosh.ApiClient.Hackney](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.ApiClient.Hackney.md): Built-in hackney-based ApiClient.

  - [Swoosh.ApiClient.Req](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.ApiClient.Req.md): Req-based ApiClient for Swoosh.

- Plug
  - [Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Plug.Swoosh.MailboxPreview.md): Plug that serves pages useful for previewing emails in development.

- Test
  - [Swoosh.TestAssertions](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.TestAssertions.md): This module contains a set of assertions functions that you can import in your
test cases.
  - [Swoosh.X.TestAssertions](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.X.TestAssertions.md): Experimental New TestAssertions Module that may replace the old new in v2.

- Deprecated
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.OhMySmtp](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.OhMySmtp.md): 
**Deprecated - use MailPace now**
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Sendinblue](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Sendinblue.md): **Deprecated - use Brevo now**

- Exceptions
  - [Swoosh.Adapters.Mua.MultihostError](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.Adapters.Mua.MultihostError.md): Raised when no relay is used and recipients contain addresses across multiple hosts.
  - [Swoosh.AttachmentContentError](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.AttachmentContentError.md)
  - [Swoosh.DeliveryError](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Swoosh.DeliveryError.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix swoosh.mailbox.server](https://swoosh.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Swoosh.Mailbox.Server.md): Starts the mailbox preview server.
